task: DMC v3 integration hardening — Task 9: review-safe v3 n8n workflow export

artifacts.expected_node_name: Resolve Schema and Build Prompts v5

generation_rules: The original export was parsed READ-ONLY and never modified; a byte-identical backup sits at tmp/backups/2026-08-06-task9/ (sha256 recorded above).

Node shapes, type versions, Airtable base/table references, the Slack channel, and every credential REFERENCE (id+name only, no values) were carried from the original export so the file imports plausibly on the owner's instance.

The five contract artifacts are embedded byte-for-byte: source-ledger-node-v3.js, claim-gate-v3.js and writer_gate.js as parameters.jsCode of the three v3 Code nodes (Run Once for All Items — each file's $input adapter is its entry point); resolve-schema-node-v5.js as jsCode of 'Resolve Schema and Build Prompts v5'; docs/writer-prompt-v5.md as the literal system message of 'Section Writer v5'.

Execution order enforced per WRITER-GATE-WIRING.md: raw evidence -> Source Ledger v3 -> Section Writer v5 -> Parse Writer Response -> Claim Gate v3 -> Writer Gate v3 -> IF both gates pass; the fail branch appends the gate retry instruction to the writer, retries at most 2 times, then stops loudly via stop-and-error after Airtable+Slack reporting.

The legacy /render call was replaced with the canonical /render-v3 envelope: payload/images/brand_tokens + the six workflow version fields + workflow_verification_v3, whose verification_bundle_sha256 is computed over canonical sorted compact JSON exactly as dmc-renderer/service.py verifies it.

The render call carries a run+record-scoped Idempotency-Key and X-DMC-Correlation-ID; the key is reused verbatim across retryOnFail attempts and review upload file names derive from it, so retries never duplicate uploads.

Response handling routes rejected (422), draft (202), review_candidate (200), ship_ready (200) and — via the HTTP error output — timeout vs dependency failure to SEPARATE branches; the switch fallback output also lands in the dependency-failure branch.

Every enabled Drive upload targets the REPLACE_WITH_REVIEW_FOLDER_ID placeholder; the ship-path delivery upload and ship announcement are DISABLED with notes requiring validated release evidence. No real-looking ids were invented anywhere.
The X-DMC-Artifact-Manifest-SHA256 response header is captured and written to the Airtable record together with the workflow-verification hash and the Drive links.

Large run inputs (source ledger, claim records, asset manifest, editorial analysis, composition payload) persist as a Drive binary JSON artifact; no Airtable field ever receives the source-ledger JSON or any JSON.stringify blob — Airtable stores only status labels, hashes, and links.

The export is INACTIVE, review-labeled in its name, and its webhook path is report-generator-v3-review so it cannot collide with the deployed workflow. pinData was dropped (it can contain real client data).
